$comment: How each app's builds are versioned, per platform and environment. scripts/check-versions.mjs checks every minAppVersion against this. Schemes: "date" = build date yy.MM.dd (Xcode Cloud sets it on production builds), "fixed" = every build carries the same version (give it in "version"), "semver" = an increasing major.minor.patch. A platform left out here is not checked.
